site.name: Physics Playground
site.tagline: Physics experiments you can play with right in your browser.
site.description: Interactive physics simulations for students: free fall, a spring launcher, a draining bucket and an electric field. Nothing to install.

home.heroText: Pick an experiment, change anything you like and see what happens. On Earth, on Mars or on the Moon.
home.heroCanvasLabel: A ball falls to the ground. The faint circles show where the ball was every quarter of a second.

sim.comingSoonText: We're moving it from Python to the website. Until then, you can see the original version on GitHub.

free-fall.title: Free fall
free-fall.blurb: A heavy object and a light one are dropped together. Which lands first?

spring-launcher.title: Spring launcher
spring-launcher.blurb: Squeeze the spring, pick an angle and launch the ball. How far does it go?

bucket.title: Draining bucket
bucket.blurb: Water pours out through a hole. Why is it fast at first and slow at the end?

electric-field.title: Electric field
electric-field.blurb: Electric charges pull and push. Follow a particle as it moves between them.

footer.privacy: No ads, no accounts, no tracking.
